requirement_references.note: Requires one claimant-facing external-service scenario with participant, consent, input, output, status, and failure boundaries.
Requires revision and authority checks, idempotent retries, and an honest claimant state and next step.
The exact Key Feature 2 wording is not present in the repository and must be confirmed before this scenario is presented as challenge-feature coverage.

participant.purpose: Request an assessor assignment for a created motor claim without granting access to the complete claim or making a coverage, liability, repair-authorisation, or fraud decision.

consent.claimant_prompt: With your permission, Northwind can share the minimum claim and location details needed to request a vehicle damage assessment. This does not decide coverage or approve repairs. Do you want us to continue?
consent.withdrawal_boundary: Consent may be withdrawn until the external request is accepted; after acceptance, Northwind records the withdrawal and coordinates any cancellation through an authorised service path.

minimum_input.name: claim_id
minimum_input.purpose: Scope the request to one Working Claim.

minimum_input.name: external_claim_id
minimum_input.purpose: Link the task to the matching created external claim.

minimum_input.name: authorisation_ref
minimum_input.purpose: Prove that a controlled rule or authorised staff decision permits routing.

minimum_input.name: claimant_consent_ref
minimum_input.purpose: Prove that the claimant or authorised representative permitted the task-specific disclosure.

minimum_input.name: requested_action
minimum_input.purpose: Limit the participant to vehicle damage assessment routing.

minimum_input.name: location.region
minimum_input.purpose: Select an eligible regional queue without sharing a full address at the routing stage.

excluded_input: raw evidence bytes or unrestricted evidence access
coverage, liability, fraud, approval, rejection, or repair-authorisation decision

status_lifecycle.claimant_meaning: Nothing has been shared; Northwind is waiting for the claimant's permission.
Consent and Northwind routing authority are recorded, but no external request is yet confirmed.
Northwind is attempting the provider-neutral request and must not report an assignment yet.
The service accepted the request into a queue; an individual assessor may not yet be assigned.
The service confirmed an assessor assignment and returned the next step.
No success is claimed; the current claim is preserved with an honest limitation.

failure_outcomes.claimant_wording: The assessment request did not complete. Your claim is saved; Northwind can safely retry the same request.
failure_outcomes.retry_expectation: Retry only with the same idempotency identity and unchanged input under a controlled retry policy.

failure_outcomes.claimant_wording: The assessment service is unavailable right now. Your claim is saved, and no assessor has been assigned.
failure_outcomes.retry_expectation: A controlled retry may occur later; do not fall through to a different provider or fixture.

failure_outcomes.claimant_wording: We could not send the assessment request because its authorisation was not accepted. Northwind must review the request before trying again.
failure_outcomes.retry_expectation: Do not retry automatically; obtain corrected authority or access configuration first.

failure_outcomes.claimant_wording: The assessment service returned an unusable response. Your claim is saved; Northwind must review the integration response.
failure_outcomes.retry_expectation: Do not repair or reinterpret the provider response into success; review the adapter mapping before retrying.

idempotency.identical_retry: Return the previously accepted provider-neutral result without creating a second task.
idempotency.changed_payload: Reject reuse of the same operation identity with an idempotency conflict.

claimant_success_wording: Your vehicle damage assessment request has been accepted. We will show the assigned assessor or queue and the next step once confirmed; this does not decide coverage or approve repairs.
known_limitations: This is a controlled scenario contract, not evidence that a production assessor provider is connected.
The adapter fixture validates claimant_consent_ref, but the claimant-facing consent capture experience remains work for issue #262.
The fixture implements deterministic success and failure outcomes; it is not evidence that a production assessor provider is connected.
The exact Challenge Key Feature 2 wording remains outside the repository and must be verified before claiming complete challenge coverage.
Northwind production retry counts, timeouts, cancellation behaviour, participant access, and service-level timings remain unapproved.
